name: lib CRC32 dedup + reconsider PNG decode order (#10, #8)
description:
Owns lib/descramble.js, lib/zip.js, new lib/crc32.js. See plan Task 3.
- #10 (minor): extract ONE shared lib/crc32.js exporting the offset form crc32(u8,start,len). zip.js + descramble.js import it. zip.js's whole-buffer callers -> crc32(data,0,data.length). test/zip.test.js imports crc32 from zip.js -> keep zip.js re-exporting (or update test import). npm test must stay green.
- #8 (important, RECONSIDER/likely defer): current 'custom PNG parser first' order (decodeToRgba, descramble.js:536) is a CORRECTNESS choice — decodeViaBitmap round-trips createImageBitmap->canvas (lossy premultiply/color-mgmt, corrupts ORM/normal maps). npm test CANNOT catch a regression (Node lacks ImageDecoder/createImageBitmap). If pursued: prefer ImageDecoder ONLY (exact copyTo RGBA), never move canvas path ahead of custom parser; requires manual browser pixel comparison. Otherwise return 'no change, premise did not hold'.
Verify: npm test (zip/descramble/orm) green.

name: background+offscreen: SW keepalive, download fallback, badge (#1,#3,#7,#9,#12)
description:
Owns background.js + offscreen/offscreen.js. Do NOT touch manifest.json or DEBUG. See plan Task 4.
- #1 (critical, VERIFY FIRST): setInterval keepalive (background.js:124-131) is the standard working MV3 pattern; getPlatformInfo resets the 30s idle timer. chrome.alarms min period 30s >= 30s idle => naive swap REGRESSES. Reproduce a real SW-death-during-download first; if none, leave as-is (valid PASS). If real, prefer hybrid (keep setInterval + alarm backstop), and tell Task 1 to add 'alarms' permission.
- #3 (critical): keep blob primary. Add data-URL fallback on BOTH failure paths: (a) download() callback lastError/no downloadId (background.js:277), (b) downloads.onChanged -> interrupted (background.js:358). Fallback: request raw bytes from offscreen (offscreen.js currently keeps only the object URL, L55 — must ALSO retain Blob/bytes per id, freed on revoke/confirm), build chunked-base64 data:<mime> URL in SW, retry download once. Note memory cost.
- #7 (important): chrome.action.setBadgeText progress badge (action key exists, manifest:11); clear on queue drain / failJob / finishSave.
- #9 (minor): drop 'WORKERS' from offscreen reasons (background.js:176), keep 'BLOBS'; confirm no Worker spawned first (declarative only).
- #12 (minor): remove typeof chrome.downloads.search guard (background.js:364), call directly.
Verify: npm test green + manual: real download lands via blob; badge shows/clears.
